notes: Advanced Voice + Live Mode. Text-to-speech (TTS) and speech-to-text (STT) across OpenAI, Groq, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Cartesia, AssemblyAI and free Microsoft Edge TTS (no key, online). Read-aloud with pause/resume/stop, voice/language/speed selection, and automatic reading of replies (opt-in). Hands-free Live Mode (TALK / READ / START_TASKS) over the existing system microphone, with voice commands (pause/resume/mute/repeat/stop, destructive actions need confirmation). Voice settings screen with connection/playback tests, per-provider encrypted API keys, and estimated token/cost recording in the Token & Cost Manager. The existing microphone and device dictation remain the default and are unchanged. Ported/adapted from AndroidHarness 4.0 (MIT) with attribution. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2).
